name: iS5 Quick Start Guide - (iMSS) Rev. 1.pdf
text:
[p1]
iS5 Quick Start Guide
iS5 provides two software access application tool options for our customers to
select from. Each of these tree/branch style navigation tools will enable and
optimize your Ethernet Switch and accelerate the equipment implementation
process quickly and easily with virtually no learning curve. You can choose either
the iManage Software Suite (iMSS) or the Web Browser version.
Although both options are easy to use and provide a simple graphical user
interface that allows you to quickly configure your switch, the available features
and capabilities do differ from each other. The Web Browser version already
comes preloaded on each switch and provides the functionality you will need to
fully configure the switch. The iManage Software Suite combines the basic
functions of our Web Browser tool providing maximum utilization and control of
the unit. The advanced enhancements provide a more powerful feature rich
configuration tool with added monitoring and analytic options while still
delivering ease of use performance and flexibility (see below for details).
If you wish to utilize our full feature software suite (iMSS) then you will need to
install the iManage executable file that is loaded on the USB drive that is
enclosed with your switch. The iManage software will require about 75MB of
space on your PC/Laptop, for all guidelines please see (System Requirements)
end of Page 5. We offer up to 50 FREE node connections with this software suite,
additional nodes can be purchased.
Application file
iManage Application
iManage is composed of two tools iViewer and Provisioning Tool they offer
additional features and capabilities that you won’t find in the Web Browser
version, such as…

[p2]
iManage (iViewer)
Topology Wizard
• Topology Wizard – Is the first screen you will see when you launch the
iViewer application. It allows you to automatically discover and detect all iS5
switches within a specified IP Address Range and also enables you the option
to load an existing topology file.
Device Tree/Group Tree Panel
• Detected Devices/Topology – Once the connected devices are detected in
the Device Tree/Group Tree panel(s) (as shown above), a graphical topology
view of all your iS5 switches in a network will appear in the Topology panel.
• Map – Displays topology of network connection locations on Google Maps in
the Map panel.
• SNMP Traps – Lists the status of all your links in the bottom panel below the
Topology/Map panel.
• Telnet – This is the remote command line interface to the switch Allows you
to login to each switch by right clicking on the IP Address in the Device
Tree/Group Tree panel(s).

[p3]
• Open Web – Allows you to open a web browser for GUI provisioning by
logging in with the Web Browser using the User ID & Password credentials in
the Web Browser Application section.
• Log Event – Displays time stamped real time recorded events in the System
Event Log. It includes information for all Ports, Power Supplies and device
Start Up.
• Link Status – Displays the ‘Up’ or ‘Down’ status of each individual Port link in
a spreadsheet list format.
• Port Performance – Allows you to query any or all Ports. After selecting your
Ports and clicking on Apply a new view screen will launch displaying the Port
performance on a color coded graph.
iManage (Provisioning Tool)
Main Navigation Tree Panel
• Devices – In the Main Navigation Tree panel above, under Device branch all
the devices found in your network will be identified. The center navigation
panel, All Functions allows you to fully provision each device that has been
identified under the Devices branch.
• Status Monitor – Displays the status points of any Fault’s in your switch for
all Ports and Power Supplies in a spreadsheet list format with fields like Beep
Alarm, IP, MAC Address.
• Scan Device Configuration – Scans your network for all connected devices
and provides information in a spreadsheet list format – ie. Kernel Ver.
Firmware Ver., IP Address, Status etc.
• Syslog Events – Displays time stamped real time recorded events, including
Login and out information in a spreadsheet list format

[p4]
• Wizards
• Group IP Setting – Allows you to change a group of IP addresses in a
simple walkthrough process.
• Group Firmware Update – Allows you to update the firmware to all your
devices at once.
• Group Configuration Backup – Allows you to backup all your network
devices configurations to any server or PC.
• Group Configuration Restore – Allows you to restore all your network
devices configurations from your server or PC.
• Group iRing Setting – Allows you to create a ring topology or change an
existing one (ie. RSTP, MSTP) to an iRing only Topology.

[p5]
Web Browser Application
You can access the preloaded Web Browser software on your switch by
connecting an Ethernet cable to any of the RJ45 Ethernet ports on the device.
Open a web browser and type in the IP address below. The following are the
credentials to access the switch.
IP Address: 192.168.10.1
User ID: admin
Password: admin
If you are having trouble accessing this device please contact Tech Support at:
Toll Free: 1-844-475-8324 (1-844-iS5-TECH)
Telephone: + 1 905-670-0004
Technical Support: support@is5com.com
System Requirements
Software Requirements
Operating System Windows 2000/20003/XP/Vista/Win7
Internet Explorer 6.0 Service Pack 1 or
Browser
Higher Version
Hardware Requirements
CPU Intel Core 2 Duo 2.4GHz or above
RAM 1G or above
Hard Disk Space 1G or above

[p6]
FTP Software Downloads
Our latest firmware version can always be found on our FTP site. If you wish to
access our FTP site for further software downloads please contact iS5 support to
obtain access at Technical Support: support@is5com.com
FTP://ftp.is5com.wnmh.net
